Currently
column2: GRO can do unlimited recursion through the gro_receive

column1: handlers.  This was fixed for tunneling protocols by limiting tunnel GRO
to one level with encap_mark
column2: but both VLAN and TEB still have this

column1: problem.  Thus
column2: the kernel is vulnerable to a stack overflow

column1: receive a packet composed entirely of VLAN headers.
This patch adds a recursion counter to the GRO layer to prevent stack
overflow.  When a gro_receive function hits the recursion limit
aborted for this skb and it is processed normally.  This recursion
counter is put in the GRO CB
column2: but could be turned into a percpu counter

column1: if we run out of space in the CB.
Thanks to Vladimír Beneš <vbenes@redhat.com> for the initial bug report.
